statement: SDL Wii HIDAPI resets packet/report mode on all 0x20. When MotionPlus mode is active it does not directly interpret base extension bit as ordinary hotplug; it conditionally schedules stage 1 A400FE/2 then stage 2 A600FE/2 checks. When MP inactive, an extension presence mismatch marks joystick disconnected for reinit. SDL on Linux delegates A600FE mapping to the kernel; neither branch reads F6. No status edge means no edge-specific reinit, though periodic checks may continue.

applicability.revision: Original external MotionPlus and integrated Remote Plus distinguished where possible; retail revision not measured
